name: Formal_Constraint_Relaxation
description: Define the scheduling problem using formal mathematical constraints (shift limits, sequential processing, equipment capacity). Then, define the infeasibility certificates (`JOB i` and `LOAD c`) as the impossibility of specific relaxed subsets of these constraints. This forces the model to logically deduce the underlying arithmetic bounds ($p1+p2 > T$ and $\Sigma p > T$) from the relaxed constraint systems, breaking simple pattern matching while keeping the mathematical task perfectly identical to the seed.
